name: Tatiana Kadumakov
original_name: タチアナ =カドゥマコフ
source:
A pure-bred Russian beauty with fair skin and big breasts.

She is an intelligence agent dispatched to Japan on a mission from the Russian Foreign Intelligence Service.

Her role is to "quickly detect and prevent the actions of groups attempting to intervene in the Northern Territories." Particularly concerning for Russia is the presence of such groups in Hokkaido, and since she needs a public face, she has been assigned as the Deputy Consul General at the Russian Consulate General in Sapporo for the past three years.

Although Tatyana understands the importance of her mission, she secretly feels jealous of her colleagues—agents sent to the Russian Embassy in Tokyo for "gathering information on diplomatic negotiations," who seem to be in more glamorous positions.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.turumiku.jp/product/hototogisu/]official site[/url]]
